text:
olivia: Quick recap from today's DR game day. High-level: failover routing worked but we saw delayed KV syncs in eu-west-1 -> us-east-1. Follow-ups below.

sanjay: Thanks. I captured notes and action items in the doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/DR/pages/12345

liam: TL;DR on the KV sync: it lagged ~2m when we scaled read-replicas during the burst. Repro steps in thread.

jessica: Owners: I can take the restore runbook updates. Will open PR today.

olivia: Assigning owners: 
- KV replication tuning -> sanjay (ETA 2026-04-10)
- Runbook for full-region restore -> jessica (ETA 2026-03-30)
- DNS failover automation test -> liam (ETA 2026-04-03)
- Backups verification cadence -> ops-oncall (recurring)

sanjay: Ack. I'll add a short checklist and perf numbers to the runbook. Plan: increase replication window, add backpressure metric, test with 10k writes/min.

liam: For DNS automation, I'll add synthetic test and a rollback hook. Using route53 weighted failover; will add health checks and a canary traffic shift script.

jessica: PR for runbook opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops-runbooks/pull/789 :eyes:

deploy-bot: deployment started for runbook PR #789

deploy-bot: deployment succeeded in staging

ops-oncall: For backups, I propose weekly integrity check + monthly restore drill. Adding a calendar invite for the first drill 2026-04-06.

olivia: Good. Also flagging a recurring incident pattern: multi-region traffic surges correlate with model cache misses causing cold KV loads. Action: caching policy + pre-warm on model rollout.

sanjay: Will instrument additional metrics: kv_cache_miss_rate and kv_repair_events. Adding alerts: kv_cache_miss_rate > 5% for 10m -> paging.

liam: Quick command I used during game-day to simulate traffic:
```
hey loadgen --qps 2000 --model rwd-70b --routes /chat
```

jessica: Noted. For the restore runbook I'll include exact S3 restore commands, kms steps, and a checklist to verify data integrity (sha256).

olivia: Can each owner paste a single-line ack with ETA? We want to close the follow-ups by next check-in.

sanjay: sanjay: ack - ETA 2026-04-10
liam: liam: ack - ETA 2026-04-03
jessica: jessica: ack - ETA 2026-03-30
ops-oncall: ops-oncall: ack - weekly checks starting 2026-04-06

olivia: Added to action tracker: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DR-OPS-452. I'll run weekly check-ins on Mondays.

liam: Can we also add a post-change smoke test to Dedicated capacity scale events? quick yes/no.

jessica: yes from me
sanjay: yes
ops-oncall: yes

olivia: Perfect. Closing notes: next game-day in 6 weeks, owners will report status in the incident channel before the run. :white_check_mark:

ops-oncall: calendar invite created. Reminder set.

olivia: Thanks all, good job today. If anyone hits blockers ping me directly.
